title: Grateful Dead Live at Community Concourse on 1970-01-10
lineage: RX (purported 2nd gen) > Technics RS-1506 > Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] > Korg MR-1000 > DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] > Korg AudioGate > wav [24/96]

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard recording; the band is on fire with a soaring Mason’s Children and fierce China Cat Sunflower.
ai_review.review: The SirMick‑sourced soundboard capture is praised as great, delivering excellent clarity throughout. Musically the Dead are “really on,” with Mason’s Children singled out as a highlight and China Cat Sunflower described as fierce, while the set’s unusually brief song lengths give it a fresh, punchy feel. Overall the show is considered a strong early‑70 performance, especially for fans of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated around 4/5 (energetic playing, standout songs) and recording quality is excellent (5/5); weighted combination yields ~4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the sound "great" and "crystal‑clear"; no issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set is concise with unusually brief song lengths, which some find refreshing; overall flow is energetic and the band feels tightly in sync.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His playing is highlighted as fierce and exemplary.
